name: m4-devirt-sym-jit
description: JIT pilot for step 2 of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199). In `m4-devirt-sym-prof2`, step 2 removed its targeted vtable stubs but compiler-thread instructions did not move, and `AsSeenFromMap.isTypeParamOfEnclosingClass` and the `mapConserve` call in `TypeRef.mapOver` became real calls. This records the JIT over each whole fork (`jitRecording`) to find, with `jit_diff`, the inlining decisions that changed. `step2aa` is a second fork of step 2: an A/A, to tell real changes from profile pollution.
Scala corpus, single-shot 4+4, one fork per variant, no profiler; patched JDK 26, `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`.
